chapters.label: Live from the Bridge
chapters.text: Stamford Bridge, 2024: Chelsea against Bournemouth. Keeper Neto rushes out and wins the ball, but Gallagher chases him, and his clearance goes wrong. Caicedo is waiting. He steps in and shoots from near halfway. Over the keeper... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. The ball sails over the stranded keeper and dips under the bar, before a defender can head it. His first Chelsea goal!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: How he does it: watch the passer's eyes and hips. They point where the ball will go. Guess the pass, step in, steal it, then go!
